hookId.description: The hook that gives the most of the need; null when none gives any of it

input.description: The inputs it was sampled with, as a page sends them

covers.description: What the design shows that the hook gives, each with its path from the root of the output, [] for each item of a list: team crest → matches[].teams[0].logo

missing.description: What the design shows that the hook does not give

why.description: One or two lines: why this hook over the others looked at

apis.description: With no hook: the connector ids that could give it, best first
